name: rate-my-representatives-app

scripts.test:security: pnpm generate:contracts && vitest run packages/auth/src/authentication.abuse.test.ts packages/auth/src/authentication.recovery.test.ts packages/auth/src/no-social-credit.test.ts apps/api/src/authorization.contract.test.ts packages/config/src/index.test.ts packages/domain/src/audit-outbox.test.ts packages/db/src/audit-outbox.test.ts packages/observability/src/index.test.ts
